1. Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. 2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -5.78% | 1M: -9.93%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit stress rising: Credit Spread (HYG/LQD) (1W: +0.70% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND → flat; Stocks vs Bonds improving: SPY (1W: +1.71% | 1M: -1.43%) RECOVERY ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

Biotech/Health leading: XBI (1W: +4.57% | 1M: +17.28%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing strength: XLF (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +6.89%) ABOVE TREND. Tech patchy: XLK (1W: +1.40% | 1M: -5.07%) RECOVERY — style mixed with cyclicals gaining but breadth narrow.

5. US vs Global?

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation showing pockets of risk-on: ARKK (1W: +6.69% | 1M: +0.73%) ABOVE TREND and Speculation Index rising; IBIT (1W: +0.38% | 1M: -16.03%) RECOVERY shows crypto flows mixed.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Copper RECOVERY: CPER (1W: +2.48% | 1M: -6.88%) RECOVERY; precious metals short-term bounce: GLD (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -9.89%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -20.82%) RECOVERY — overall commodity momentum uneven.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy weak: XLE (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -7.17%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -24.92%) BELOW TREND; natural gas soft: UNG (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -0.17%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Financials XLF (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +6.89%) ABOVE TREND and Healthcare XLV (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE (MAJOR): SPY (1W: +1.71% | 1M: -1.43%) RECOVERY, XLK (1W: +1.40% | 1M: -5.07%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +0.43%) CORRECTION show 1W/1M mismatches across core ETFs, so avoid strong directional bets.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor Financials and defensive healthcare/biotech exposure given XLF (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +6.89%) ABOVE TREND and XBI (1W: +4.57% | 1M: +17.28%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to energy and select EM risk while monitoring credit stress (HYG/LQD).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Biotech XBI (1W: +4.57% | 1M: +17.28%) ABOVE TREND and Healthcare XLV (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -7.17%) BELOW TREND and China FXI (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -8.86%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper CPER (1W: +2.48% | 1M: -6.88%) RECOVERY if industrial cues improve.  
BEARISH: Oil BNO (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -24.92%) BELOW TREND on weak demand signals.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~22 (complacency threshold); Credit Spread HYG/LQD ~0.73 (credit health); SPY/TLT ~8.72 (stock vs bond balance); XLK/XLF ratio ~3.39 (tech vs financials pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, mixed signals with VXX falling but credit stress elevated. XBI (1W: +4.57% | 1M: +17.28%) and XLF (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +6.89%) showing relative strength. Key risk: major 1W/1M divergence across SPY (1W: +1.71% | 1M: -1.43%), XLK (1W: +1.40% | 1M: -5.07%) and TLT (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +0.43%) — monitor credit spread and tech momentum.
